abstract: Conducts chemical bench trials, pilot contaminant recovery tests, and chemical reagent validation
system_message:
You are the Process Chemistry Specialist (PRC). Your business responsibilities are to conduct chemical bench trials, pilot contaminant recovery tests, and chemical reagent validation, as well as to monitor slurry acidity stabilization across evaluated remediation strategies.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Slurry acidity stabilization（PHMOD）
information_points.content:
PRC-PHMOD-DWV：Regarding slurry acidity stabilization for in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge, bench monitoring of the post-wash discharge recorded a slurry effluent pH of 7.2 1.
PRC-PHMOD-7BV：Regarding slurry acidity stabilization for ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification, post-wash neutralization logs indicate a slurry effluent pH of 7.6 1.
PRC-PHMOD-MIR：Regarding slurry acidity stabilization for surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers, bench logs for the discharge vessel recorded a slurry effluent pH of 6.8 1.

information_points.title: Conducts chemical bench trials, pilot contaminant recovery tests, and chemical reagent validation（TREAT）
information_points.content:
PRC-TREAT-HDP：For the ex-situ soil washing with cementitious solidification remediation strategy, pilot scale contaminant extraction testing was conducted on an on-site 500-tonne trial batch. Results showed a pilot contaminant extraction efficiency of 78 %, and the heavy metals stabilization agent is certified for inorganic binding.
PRC-TREAT-1RK：For the in-situ thermal desorption with perimeter biosparge remediation strategy, pilot scale contaminant extraction testing was conducted on an on-site 500-tonne trial batch of halogenated hydrocarbon soil. Analytical testing confirmed a pilot contaminant extraction efficiency of 92 %, and the heavy metals stabilization agent is certified under standard leaching procedure thresholds.
PRC-TREAT-Q30：For the surfactant-enhanced aquifer flushing with reactive barriers remediation strategy, pilot scale contaminant extraction testing was conducted on an on-site 500-tonne trial batch. The trial demonstrated a pilot contaminant extraction efficiency of 86 %, and the heavy metals stabilization agent is certified.
